tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250dpal rta mgrin dregs pa kun 'dul gyi gsol 'debs byin rlabs grub ster bzhugs so// 1$0000300gsung gi rdo rje rta mchog he ru ka /gsang ba kun 'dzin phyag na rdo rje la// gsol ba 'debs so bdud bzhi'i bar chad sol// byin gyis rlobs shig dbang dang dngos grub stsol// o rgyan grub pa'i rgyal po gzi brjid zhabs// ma hā rā dza che dang pra hastir// gsol ba 'debs so bdud bzhi'i bar chad sol// byin gyis rlobs shig dbang dang dngos grub stsol// go ma de wī padma thod phreng rtsal// chos rgyal khri srong lo chen bai ro la// gsol ba 'debs so bdud bzhi'i bar chad sol// byin gyis rlobs shig dbang dang dngos grub stsol// zab gter mnga' bdag gru gu yang dbang gter// lung zin chos bdag brgyud par bcas pa la// gsol ba 'debs so bdud bzhi'i bar chad sol// byin gyis rlobs shig dbang dang dngos grub stsol// padma khrag 'thung ye shes rnam rol che// byin rlabs mchog stsol rtsa ba'i bla ma la// gsol ba 'debs so bdud bzhi'i bar chad sol// byin gyis rlobs shig dbang dang dngos grub stsol// dkyil 'khor khyab bdag dbang chen rta mchog dpal// rigs bzhi'i khro bo'i rgyal po yab yum la// gsol ba 'debs so bdud bzhi'i bar chad sol// byin gyis rlobs shig dbang dang dngos grub stsol// rdo rje mkha' lding sprul pa'i khro bo bcu// sgo skyong bzhi sogs lha tshogs yongs rdzogs la// gsol ba 'debs so bdud bzhi'i bar chad sol// byin gyis rlobs shig dbang dang dngos grub stsol// dbang gis rgyud smin dam tshig rnam par dag /bskyed rdzogs zab mos gnyis snang bdud tshogs bcom// tshar gcod rjes 'dzin phrin las lhun gyis grub// padma dbang chen go 'phang myur thob shog /
ces rtsa sde spyan snga nam mkha' rdo rjes mdzad pa'i yig rnying la zhu bcos phran bu bcas bris pa dge// /
